bird_people.name: Person with a shoe on one foot
The cuchoo: in search of lost horse
The cuckoo: in search of lost sibling
Pubic hair for a bird’s crest
A marooned man returns home before his adversary
Humans in the south, birds in the north
Woman from sky-world marries mortal man

cosmic_serpent.name: Milky Way is a serpent or fish

world_centre.name: A man and a woman hold the earth
Polaris is a pole, a nail

bird_people.name: The Sun-bird
bird_people.description: A bird incorporates the Sun or the day light. It can be caught, let free, killed

bird_people.name: Person with a shoe on one foot
bird_people.description: While being transformed into a bird or ascending to the sky a person was in a hurry and put a footwear only on one foot, or somebody attempted to seize him grasping his foot. Now the corresponding bird or a sky-person is believed to have different feet

bird_people.name: Overtaken by the first night
bird_people.description: When night escapes from container where it was originally preserved, men surprised by the darkness turn into birds or animals

bird_people.name: Offended children abandon parents
bird_people.excluded: offended children abandon parents: transformation is incidental and not necessarily into birds
bird_people.description: Children conflict with their parents who do not pay them enough attention, condemn their sexual behavior, do not give them enough food, clothes, etc.; the children abandon their parents and become birds, bats, atmospheric phenomena, or stars (usually the Pleiades)

bird_people.name: Buzzard husband
bird_people.description: Man thinks that buzzard or hawk has better life than he. They exchange clothes. The bird lives with the man's wife as her husband, the man usually does not enjoy his bird life

bird_people.name: The thirsty cuckoo
bird_people.description: Children do not give water to their mother or mother to her child. The offended person turns into a bird, usually a cuckoo

bird_people.name: Offended one turns into bird
bird_people.description: Children do not give water to their thirsty mother or mother (step mother, stepfather) does not give water to thirsty child. The offended one turns into a bird and flies away

bird_people.name: The cuchoo: in search of lost horse
bird_people.description: A girl (with her brother; two small brothers) is (are) in search of the horse or cattle or the girl is in search of her lost brother. She (alone or with her brother; both brothers) turns into a bird (usually a cuckoo; or both siblings turn into birds) that cries in specific way

bird_people.name: The cuckoo: in search of lost sibling
bird_people.description: Girl searches for her lost brother, calls him or brother calls his sister, or they call each other, or two lost brothers call each other. One or both siblings turn into birds with specific cry

bird_people.name: Vulture-wife
bird_people.description: Man marries vulture-woman

bird_people.name: Swan-wife
bird_people.description: Man marries swan- (or goose-, duck-, crane-)woman; supernatural woman takes form of a swan, etc.

bird_people.name: Ducks and canoes
bird_people.excluded: ducks and canoes: people learn from birds; no bird-person
bird_people.description: People learn from aquatic birds how to make canoes or how to paddle; or the first canoe is a transformed bird or is made of bird bones

bird_people.name: Men turn into birds
bird_people.description: Young men and boys turn into birds or bats, fly away

bird_people.name: Pubic hair for a bird’s crest
bird_people.description: A bird person gets his crest putting on his head a pubic hair of a woman or part of her genitals

bird_people.name: The thunderbirds
bird_people.description: Creatures that produce rain and/or thunderstorms are birds or anthropomorphic beings with wings; or (rare) some or all birds are connected with thunder, lightning or rain though Thunder is not a bird

bird_people.name: Hairs into animals, scales into fish
bird_people.excluded: hairs into animals: creator makes birds, no bird-person
bird_people.description: Master of living beings sends down, hairs, scales, etc. which turn into birds, animals, fish

bird_people.name: Woman turns into duck
bird_people.description: A girl or two sisters marry a valuable partner. His rival kills or attempts to kill him or his wives. As a consequence, the women turn into water birds

bird_people.name: A marooned man returns home before his adversary
bird_people.description: A man marooned on an islet or rock in the sea turns into a bird and flies home. When the man who marooned him comes home, the hero is already there

bird_people.name: Nestlings turn into eagles
bird_people.excluded: nestlings turn into eagles: birds into birds
bird_people.description: Hero transforms nestlings or monster bird into common eagles or owls

bird_people.name: Feathers turn into birds
bird_people.excluded: feathers turn into birds: birds into birds
bird_people.description: Feathers of giant bird turn into different present day birds

bird_people.name: Humans in the south, birds in the north
bird_people.description: A man gets to the country inhabited by migratory birds. They have there human guise but turn into birds going back to the north

bird_people.name: Stolen clothes of supernatural woman
bird_people.description: Women who possess supernatural power and usually come from a non-human world (from sky, from under the water, they are winged beings, bird- or animal-persons) take off their clothes (feather skins and the like) or part of it. After the man hides clothes, their owner has to marry him or help him

bird_people.name: Woman from sky-world marries mortal man
bird_people.description: A man gets a woman connected with the upper world (bird-maiden, sky fairy, star-woman, etc.), she becomes his wife or (rare) adopted daughter

bird_people.name: Magic wife finds her clothes
bird_people.description: Magic wife abandons her mortal husband when she finds her clothes (often, her feathers if she is a bird-woman), makes herself the new clothes, receives them from her kin or her husband gives her her clothing believing that she will not abandon him. (Versions with magic wife abandoning her husband because she feels herself offended is not alternative to the “found clothes but in most of the texts these motifs are not combined)

bird_people.name: True wife turns into owl
bird_people.description: When the imposter takes place of the real wife, the latter turns into owl

bird_people.name: Bird-woman kills men (The loon-woman)
bird_people.description: Bird-woman is energetically searching a man whom she likes, takes him by force for her husband. Turning into a monster, she kills men but is ultimately destroyed

bird_people.name: Animal skins as metamorphosis amulets
bird_people.description: Person temporarily turns into a bird or an animal putting on corresponding skin or animal skins are amulets that become alive and help the person

bird_people.name: The stuck in pin
bird_people.description: Person is bewitched (transformed into a bird, faints) when a pin or other sharp object is stuck into her (rare his) body

bird_people.name: Brothers transform into swans
bird_people.description: A girl has many (more than three) brothers, they turn into birds or ungulate animals (rare: they are killed by magic), ultimately become human again

bird_people.name: Blind duck-women cured
bird_people.description: A man meets two blind women, makes them see, they are or become birds (geese, ducks, grouses or the like)

bird_people.name: Raven marries goose
bird_people.description: A bird of prey or a carrion-eater (raven, owl, hawk; coyote) marries or tries to marry goose-person or other water bird. This marriage is not realized or is a short one

bird_people.name: Unlucky flight with migratory birds
bird_people.description: A bird-person who usually does not fly away in the autumn makes attempt to fly with migratory birds but is unable to reach destination

cosmic_serpent.name: Serpent pushes sky up
cosmic_serpent.description: Serpent-like creature pushes the sky far away from the earth

cosmic_serpent.name: The cloud serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: A flying reptile produces rain, thunderstorm

cosmic_serpent.name: The lightning- serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: The lightning is associated with a snake

cosmic_serpent.name: The horned serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: Giant water-chthonic or sky serpent or dragon has horns or antlers on its head

cosmic_serpent.name: A horned snake
cosmic_serpent.description: Snake of natural size has horns on its head

cosmic_serpent.name: Snake’s crown
cosmic_serpent.rule: snake turns into dragon|snake.?s crown|snake bridge
cosmic_serpent.excluded: snake's crown: treasure-guarding snake, not cosmic scale
cosmic_serpent.description: Reptiles possess treasure with magic properties. Person gets or tries to get it. Usually it is a crown, jewel or small horns on the snake's head

cosmic_serpent.name: A snake bridge
cosmic_serpent.rule: snake turns into dragon|snake.?s crown|snake bridge
cosmic_serpent.excluded: snake bridge: a snake as a rope over a river, not cosmic scale
cosmic_serpent.description: Snake, lizard or worm is a bridge or a rope over the river

cosmic_serpent.name: Rainbow serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: Rainbow is a reptile (usually a snake) or (more rare) a fish, or it is related to snake, to its tongue, breath, or to scorpion's tail

cosmic_serpent.name: Milky Way is a serpent or fish
cosmic_serpent.description: Milky Way is a reptile, fish, or chain of fish

cosmic_serpent.name: Chthonic serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: Giant serpent lies on the perimeter of the earth or supports the earth

cosmic_serpent.name: Snake turns into dragon
cosmic_serpent.rule: snake turns into dragon|snake.?s crown|snake bridge
cosmic_serpent.excluded: snake turns into dragon: no cosmic role stated
cosmic_serpent.description: After certain time a snake or fish turn into a dragon

cosmic_serpent.name: The earth is a reptile
cosmic_serpent.description: The earth is the body of a crocodile or a dragon

world_centre.name: Destruction of the world tree
world_centre.description: People ascend the tree to hunt, fish, or gather food in the sky. The tree is destroyed, people fall to earth or remain in the upper world

world_centre.name: Hit with a projectile
world_centre.excluded: hit with a projectile: Polaris as a struck animal, not an axis
world_centre.description: Ursa major or Polaris are identified with a middle size animal (ermine, fisher, woodchuck) or person (identified with an animal?) hit with a dart or arrow

world_centre.name: Primeval tree
world_centre.description: One of the trees is the principal, original one (emerged before all the other; ancestor of wild or cultivated plants; ocean or rivers inside it; world axis; higher than all the others; overshadows sky)

world_centre.name: Four supports of the world
world_centre.description: The sky or the earth rests upon four or five (cardinal points and the center) supports of any kind (poles, mountains, giants)

world_centre.name: One support of the world
world_centre.description: Only one pole or mountain supports the earth or the sky

world_centre.name: Atlas
world_centre.description: One giant supports the earth or the sky

world_centre.name: A man and a woman hold the earth
world_centre.description: Two anthropomorphic beings, a male and a female, are in the underworld and support the earth

world_centre.name: The world axis
world_centre.description: A tree or post pierces and unites different layers of the universe

world_centre.name: Fish the earth-holder
world_centre.description: World is supported by fish or fish-like monster or the earth itself is such a monster

world_centre.name: Opening of the sky
world_centre.excluded: opening of the sky: calendrical wish-granting, not a centre
world_centre.description: On a certain day, the sky vault opens and the interior of the sky is seen; usually any wish expressed at this moment will be fulfilled

world_centre.name: Stars are people
world_centre.excluded: stars are people: rule fired on 'Polaris' in a parenthesis
world_centre.description: Stars are people, ghosts, anthropomorphic beings (interpretations of unique star objects like Venus or Polaris as persons not considered)

world_centre.name: Polaris is a pole, a nail
world_centre.description: Polaris is a (tethering) pole or a nail

world_centre.name: Horses around Polaris
world_centre.excluded: horses around Polaris: circumpolar animals, not an axis
world_centre.description: Hoofed animals are walking around Polaris

world_centre.name: Polaris is a man
world_centre.excluded: Polaris is a man: personification, not an axis

world_centre.name: The sky door
world_centre.description: Chain of arrows is used to pull or push the sky or the Sun lower or higher or to break a hole in the sky
